Same premium mochi/jelly look as a lavender and peach candy capsule: pearly cream highlights, lavender piping, soft peach blush, pillowy bevels, subtle subsurface light. True transparent background outside the frame. Frame interior is quiet very pale cream/lilac, designed for live UI overlays. Top 16%: EMPTY space for three small character portraits. At 20–42%: broad EMPTY softly illuminated area for three large reward stars (do NOT draw stars there). At 45–66%: empty calm cream area for result text and statistics. At 69–94%: empty calm area for three stacked live action buttons. Decorative puffy gold stars and translucent opal bubbles confined to outer corners and narrow side edges, soft cotton cloud scallops around outer bottom corners, a faint oval cushion at 43% height. No text, no letters, no numbers, no buttons, no characters, no large central symbols. High resolution, polished rounded 3D casual game illustration, warm gentle celebratory atmosphere. Keep center uncluttered for animation and readable typography.
assets.mochi-reward-star.png: Use case: stylized-concept. A single premium mobile game reward star sprite on a true transparent background. Lavender pearl reflections only faintly at lower rim, broad silky glossy highlights on upper left, delicate tiny highlight at lower right, soft tactile almost edible jelly-satin material. Front orthographic view, no tilt, no perspective. Match cozy pastel lavender/peach gacha UI. Readable silhouette at small size, exquisite polished casual 3D game art. No text, no face, no eyes, no background, no platform, no external cast shadow, no sparkles outside star, no extra objects. High resolution antialiased transparent edges.
